notes: Items carry title ("Company: Position"), media:content logo (some), region, country, state, skills, category, type, description (entity-escaped HTML), pubDate (RFC 2822, +0000), expires_at (pubDate + 30 days), guid == link (permalink, no isPermaLink attribute). No CDATA. region/country/state/type/skills/expires_at are not exposed by the shared FeedEntry reader (extension owner: the backlog entry "A posting whose employer is withheld at the source has nowhere to live" in .claude/tasks/BACKLOG-followups.md, second requirement: namespaced extension elements; numbered 309 when written, the title is the address). Recruiter names/emails/phones: none in the kept items (company names and company URLs only); nothing redacted. The real title shapes the parser is tested on: a trailing space in the raw title (Askable), a second colon inside the POSITION ("Yooli: FULL TIME: Software Engineer Position - React and Rest"), a comma. Across 179 distinct titles of the four feeds fetched, none had a colon inside the company name and none lacked a colon. Permission: robots.txt (fetched 2026-10-23) allows / and disallows only account/admin paths. The official feed page and the /terms page both answered 403 with a Cloudflare "Just a moment" challenge to this client and were NOT bypassed, so neither was read directly. A search-engine excerpt of the official feed page states "Anyone can use the feed, all we ask is that you attribute the links back to We Work Remotely" and lists the all-jobs feed plus one feed per category. Permission: PUBLIC_FEED, explicit grant with a link-back condition. The RSS page (Wayback snapshot 2026-10-25, https://web.archive.org/web/20261025102519/https://weworkremotely.com/remote-job-rss-feed) states: "Anyone can use the feed, all we ask is that you attribute the links back to We Work Remotely." We must link back to the We Work Remotely URL of every posting shown (the RSS link/guid is that URL). The Terms and Conditions (updated 2026-10-23; Wayback snapshot 2026-11-13, https://web.archive.org/web/20261113085856/https://weworkremotely.com/terms-and-conditions) have no clause on scraping, robots, RSS or automated access.
